structure.note: All processing parameters are stored in every preset and every structure; 2B/5B SWITCH (String 5band/2band) selects the structure. The tables do not depend on structure, pre-emphasis or low latency: no conversion reads runtime state. 'LL' (low-latency) presets differ by values only, e.g. BASS CLIP MODE LLHard (index 3); 50/75 us factory presets differ by values only (PRE-E itself is the system parameter).

page_sources.dropped: all (screen function pushes no page title)

layout_notes: Pages, order, titles, labels and x/y come from the PC Remote's PEG screen code (builder 0x41a8a0 args name,label,x,y; Advanced Modify list rows 0x40a200 use the parameter's short label). x/y are PEG screen pixels of the builder call; list rows have no fixed position (y is the row order x 20). w is a nominal 60, id is the builder call address, reference_dialog the address of the page title push; groups are not modelled (empty). kind is 'radio' for a choice table of <= 4 entries, else 'slider'.
Pages with the same title for the 2-band and 5-band structures are split as '(Two Band)'/'(Five Band)' when their controls differ; identical variants (only a soft key differs) are merged.
System pages (Input/Output, System Setup) have path 'System'; the UI's processing view only shows 'Shared'.
Order: Basic, Intermediate, Advanced Modify, Input/Output, System Setup, by page number; Five Band before Two Band.
Structure of these pages inferred as the counterpart of a Five/Two Band page with the same title: Basic Modify 3 (Two Band), Intermediate Modify 4 (Two Band), Advanced Modify 3 (Two Band)

The app shows each Advanced Modify page as a processing category with explicit sections (APP_PAGES: the worksheet's Advanced Modify headings, the client's row order); Advanced Modify 6 is split into Band Mix and Coupling. Every control of a client page is in exactly one section.
units_note: Units from the 8400 V3.0 Setup/Parameters Worksheet by row label. Corrected against the tables: PEQ HIGH FREQ worksheet 'Hz' -> kHz (values 1.00..15.00); PEQ LOW/MID/HIGH WIDTH worksheet 'dB' -> oct; LOW BASS Q worksheet 'dB/Oct' kept as dB/oct; '%'-unit Cent values are percent x100.

open_questions: orban-protocol has no 8400 DeviceModel: 8400 documents start 'OptimodVersion=<00.08>' and files end 'End Preset\r\n' (no '<end>'); the onair.orb read from a unit (scratchpad p84/onair0.orb) has LF line ends and 0xFF padding. Document::parse needs a prefix/terminator for the 8400 before readback works. All 974 documents parse with document.rs parse_lines rules (types Int, Cent, String, UserString only).
'30 HZ HPF' is registered twice: processing (onair.orb/presets) and system (system.orb, Test Modes page). Message 48 'NAME;INDEX;TYPE:VALUE;' carries no scope: which one the unit changes is unproven.
reference_id is the ordinal of the firmware constructor call (0..273), not a protocol identifier: message 48 addresses parameters by NAME.

Writable but never stored in a document (evidence 'unobserved'): processing FC HEADROOM, CLIP DENS THR, CLIP W1, DRIVE W1, DRIVE W3, MIX W3 (registered, absent from every preset); system 400 HERTZ TONE, OPERATE, BYPASS, TONE, ACTUAL A OR D, MOD REDUC SW1/SW2, OPERATE MODE, TEST MODE, MUTE, MONITOR MUTE (transient, not in system.orb). A write to these cannot be confirmed by reading the document back. ACTUAL A OR D looks like a status; MONITOR MUTE has the same text at both indices (an action).

VU PPM and LANGUAGE are registered with value_count 1 ('VU', 'English') in both firmware and PC Remote, although the VU PPM conversion also returns 'PPM' for index 1; the profile keeps the registered count.
FREQUENCY (test tone) index 31 is the string '13.58676' verbatim from the firmware table 0x384a84 (index 32 = '15kHz'; '16kHz' at 33 is beyond value_count 33).
PEQ HIGH FREQ indices 0 and 1 both format as Cent:100 (firmware table); readback by D:index tells them apart.
COMP DRIVE: IMPACT LM100.orb (75 us, in both packages) holds Cent:1000 at D:18 where the table has Cent:170; 941 other records agree. Kept with evidence 'conflict'.
AGC DRIVE: the YORIN FM 2003 user presets hold Cent:1100 at D:22 (3.0.5 table: Cent:1200); they come from older firmware. Factory presets and unit documents agree with the 3.0.5 table.
LO/HI LATEN SW appears in the MINIMUM-DELAY factory presets (String:<High>;D:1) but has no registration in 3.0.5 firmware or PC Remote; it is not writable.
TOTAL MOD LEVEL (system.orb Cent:10000;D:0) is computed from MOD LEVEL and TEST PILOT at run time (conversion 0x1481e0 reads other parameters); excluded.

Text parameters (UserString: MY STATION, NETWORK IP/SUBNET/GATEWAY, MODEM INIT STRING, REMOTE CONTACT 1-8, passcode) and time.orb/test.orb/automation parameters are excluded from parameters.json; tables of the latter are in other_documents_tables.
